final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS risk_status, SUM(m.facetfaces) AS face_sum, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.riskeval), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(face_sum) AS avg_face_sum FROM grouped), kept AS (SELECT g.face_sum, g.record_count, g.face_sum - a.avg_face_sum AS difference FROM grouped AS g JOIN group_average AS a ON a.avg_face_sum IS NOT NULL AND g.face_sum > a.avg_face_sum) SELECT SUM(face_sum) AS total_group_sums, AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM kept
